source.title: Detailed information on the Employment Permit System (EPS)
source.authority: Government of Nepal / Department of Foreign Employment / EPS Korea Section

steps.rule: Attend biometric registration at the EPS Korea Section in Gwarko on the day before the assigned exam date with the original passport and admission card.
Arrive 1.5 hours before the exam with the original passport and admission card. Biometric verification and color-vision checking are part of the exam process.
Complete the medical examination at a designated hospital on the assigned date/time and prepare the police report online. Recheck the current hospital list and fee before payment.

For the official employment-application stage, upload the required items through the EPS process and pay the stated online fee. Exact 2026 first-phase cohort dates/checklist must come from its own future notice.

steps.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal / HRD Korea
steps.rule: EPS Korea Section transmits the employment application into Korea's SPAS/EPS system; applicants can check status using their EPS-TOPIK ID on the official EPS site.

steps.authority: Korean Ministry of Employment and Labor / Job Center / employer
steps.rule: Job matching is operated through Korea's online automated system; sending-agency staff, HRD/EPS staff or other officials cannot manually guarantee or intervene to place a specific applicant with an employer.

steps.authority: HRD Korea / EPS Korea Section Nepal
steps.rule: When an SLC/Labor Contract is forwarded, follow the current EPS Nepal contract notice and appear in person at EPS Korea Section, Gwarko to sign. A 2026 contract notice also instructs listed workers to contact the EPS office and sign within 7 days from the labor-contract date.

The general EPS process includes a 6-day pre-departure orientation/training in Bhaisepati with an online application. Current contract/departure notices must be checked because training requirements can differ by worker/test category.

steps.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal / Korea Immigration Service
steps.rule: After CCVI issuance, the baseline EPS process requires an in-person document package at EPS Korea Section, Gwarko. Do not use the historical NPR 10,700 amount as a current fee without checking the latest 2026 visa/service-fee notice.

steps.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal / Korea Visa Application Center
steps.rule: EPS Korea Section sends the CCVI/visa package for visa stamping. Visa status can be checked through the official Korea Visa Portal.

steps.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal / Department of Foreign Employment / HRD Korea
steps.rule: Use the final EPS Nepal flight notice, complete Nepal labor-approval application through FEIMS, and follow the scheduled EPS office pre-departure orientation/uniform instructions before travel.

steps.authority: EPS Korea Section Nepal / designated airline
steps.rule: The official baseline lists departure from Tribhuvan International Airport, Kathmandu, or Gautam Buddha International Airport, Bhairahawa, according to the assigned final flight.
Re-registration is described for applicants who remain on the roster and were not selected in the first year. Use only a current re-registration notice for dates and exact requirements.
